claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show two sewing machine tables with rectangular cutouts and black cast iron treadle stands.

claims.claim: The seller states an asking price
claims.evidence: Photos show the item but not its price; a pricing list is required.
Photos do not show the seller's location.

risks.risk: Whether a sewing machine head is included with either table
risks.proof: A photo showing a machine head sitting in the recess or beside the table
risks.if_unproven: priced as table only with no machine head

risks.risk: Working condition of the treadle mechanisms and foot pedals
risks.proof: A video of the treadle being pedaled so the wheel turns smoothly

risks.risk: Hidden damage to table tops such as water damage or veneer lifting
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the full surface and edges of both tops
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged or worn tops

risks.risk: Whether the green motor partially visible in photo 3 is included and functional
risks.proof: A photo of the full motor and a video of it running
risks.if_unproven: priced as motor not included or not working

risks.proof: A photo of any brand plate, serial number, or maker's mark
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age with no collectible premium

risks.risk: Stability or wobbliness of the cast iron stands
risks.proof: A video of the stand being shaken or checked for level on flat ground
risks.if_unproven: priced as wobbly or unstable stands

proof_requests: Photo of any sewing machine head included with the tables
Video of the treadle wheel turning when pedaled
Close-up photos of the full surface and edges of both table tops
Photo and video of the green motor if it is included
Photo of any brand plate or serial number
Video showing the stands are stable and not wobbly
response.reason: The witness identifies two vintage sewing machine tables on treadle stands, so the item can be priced at its worst case despite unproven inclusions and condition. The seller's price and location cannot be verified from the photos.
